item.title: Infrared polymer boasts high index and transparency
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02033-8 A bifunctional cyano-substitution synthetic strategy yields an all-organic polymer with a record-breaking refractive index of 2.53 at 750 nm, combining high infrared transparency with mechanical flexibility and solution-processability.

item.title: Low-voltage avalanche heterojunction phototransistor for infrared-to-visible upconversion
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02046-3 Researchers demonstrate infrared-to-visible upconversion using an InGaAs/InP avalanche heterojunction phototransistor. Intrinsic positive feedback provides the photocurrent for amber LED operation, producing visible emission 17,000 times brighter than incident infrared light with a breakdown voltage as low as 1.4 V.

item.title: Optical control stabilizes cold-atom comagnetometry
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02043-6 The use of tailored laser fields improves the coherence times of two co-trapped ytterbium isotopes, resulting in the rejection of magnetic-field noise by more than thirty-thousand-fold, opening the way to improved comagnetometry.

item.title: Measuring hard X-ray attosecond pulses
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02037-4 The generation and characterization of high-power X-ray attosecond pulses is a challenging research frontier in free-electron laser science. Now, researchers at the Linac Coherent Light Source have demonstrated experimental confirmation and measurement of hard X-ray pulses reaching 100-attosecond durations.

item.title: Femtosecond lasers drive nanostructuring and green applications
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02032-9 From ultra-precise nanofabrication to sustainable use cases, femtosecond lasers continue to expand their application potential.

item.title: Workhorse solid-state lasers reinvented
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02038-3 Miniature versions of famous bulk solid-state sources, notably titanium–sapphire and Nd:YAG lasers, have now become a reality. This advance has been made possible through collaborative efforts from material science, heterogeneous integration and fabrication technologies.

item.title: Deep subwavelength laser nanofabrication via upconversion
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02023-w Upconversion brings new opportunities for high-resolution laser fabrication.

item.title: Slow-motion electron camera reveals light-driven quantum jumps in graphene
item.description: Using a new slow-motion electron camera, physicists from Regensburg, Marburg and Jülich revealed how intense electric fields drive electrons in graphene, causing them to jump across energy gaps in a seemingly paradoxical manner. This was made possible by a novel combination of laser technology and electron microscopy.

Theoretical method uses light to locate anyons, potential quantum computing building blocks
item.description: Theoretical physicists at Emory University have discovered a way to use light to detect the "spectral fingerprints" of anyons—exotic quasiparticles that emerge from the collective behavior of many electrons. Their findings are published in Physical Review Letters. The work offers a new tool for the study of anyons, which hold potential as fundamental building blocks for quantum computing.

item.description: 运营商是实现5G连接及应用和业务创新的重要基石，也是网络转型的主角。作为中国三大运营商之一的中国电信，正在努力推进网络转型，为5G的到来做好准备。中国电信选择与英特尔合作，采用英特尔RSD实施方案，联手击破运营商在网络转型中的各个难题，真正做到在网络转型之路所向披靡。

item.title: Quantum sensor loop design could improve magnetic measurements for medicine and communications
item.description: Adelaide University quantum engineers have found a new way to improve some of the world's most sensitive sensors of electromagnetic fields, a breakthrough that could help advance brain imaging, medical diagnostics, communications technology and next-generation quantum devices.

item.title: 两会关注：提速降费步伐加快，三大运营商打出全新组合拳
item.description: 年两会总理提出了2017年“网络提速降费要迈出更大步伐”，并明确了三个方向：年内全部取消手机国内长途和漫游费；大幅降低中小企业互联网专线接入资费；降低国际长途电话费。为了响应政府号召，三大运营商都公布了2017年提速降费的新政，通过一些列组合拳持续推进提速降费。

item.title: Juniper今年发力电信市场：重振国内运营商业务
item.description: 日前，Juniper Networks (瞻博网络) 举办了主题为飞跃的合作伙伴大会。在会上，瞻博网络大中国区总裁林小平表示，今年Juniper将重点发力运营商、OTT、企业市场及BTI、Contrail业务。其中，运营商市场是Juniper第一要发展的市场。

item.title: 中国电信六大新举措持续推进提速降费
item.description: 今天上午，国务院新闻办公室举办国务院政策吹风会。根据会议的内容显示，2017年10月1日起，三大运营商将全部取消手机国内长途和漫游费。此外，运营商还需要进一步提速降费。作为三大运营商之一的中国电信响应国家号召，2017年中国电信推出六大新举措，持续推进提速降费。

item.title: 超260个云项目背后：华为助力运营商建好云、用好云、管好云
item.description: 作为产业界云化领域的创新中坚力量之一，以及对IT和通信皆有深刻洞察的解决方案提供者，华为IT产品线过去一年中持续在全球运营商数字化转型中发挥重要战略伙伴的作用，在市场上的表现亦是“超乎想象”，据披露已经与运营商合作展开了超过260个有关云的项目。

item.title: 中国移动智能家庭网关设备集采：上海贝尔获得50%份额

item.title: 徐直军详解视频驱动力与挑战：华为助力运营商淘金万亿级新市场
item.description: 徐直军在2017世界移动大会期间的Keynote上发表了“让视频成为运营商增长的新动力”的主题演讲。他指出，内容、视频正在重新定义电信产业，对运营商来说视频业务已成必须，华为将自己定位为运营商视频业务成功的使能者，帮助运营商发展视频业务并获得增长。

item.title: MWC 2017之无线篇：设备商5G竞赛正式打响
item.description: 在近日于西班牙巴塞罗那举行2017世界移动大会(Mobile World Congress，MWC 2017)上，5G无疑是本次展会的最大亮点之一。在此期间，各5G研发组织、运营商、设备商、学术界以及合作伙伴等产业链各方在5G研发方面的最新进展备受业界关注。其中，移动通信设备商纷纷选择在大会期间发布重磅新品和解决方案，以期在5G竞赛中占得先机。

item.title: 全国首个！内蒙古移动携手华为完成露天矿山场景5G-A千兆上行验证
item.description: 近日，中国移动内蒙古公司（简称“内蒙古移动”）联合华为技术有限公司（简称“华为”）在呼伦贝尔华能伊敏露天矿，顺利完成全国首个露天矿山场景5G-A千兆上行网络能力验证。依托 4.9GHz+F/A SUL 辅助上行技术，现场实测单用户上行峰值速率达到 1022Mbps，标志内蒙古自治区正式迈入5G-A“千兆上行”新时代，为区域数字经济高质量发展注入新动能。
